notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
description:
Activate Serra's Sanctum by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {3}{W}, creating a creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping Serra's Sanctum.
Repeat.
